newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Livzon '96 net reaches 81 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Livzon '96 net reaches 81 mln yuan.

text.p: Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc had net profits of 81.44 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Earnings per share were 0.41 yuan and turnover reached 721.13 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company had net profits of 72.76 million yuan based on international standards.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 80.15 million yuan on turnover of 682.74 million yuan under Chinese accounting standards.
The company proposed no dividend for 1996 but proposed a three-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Monday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
